items.title: Cardioband Scrutiny Widens Across European Hospitals
items.title_zh: 苏黎世心脏外科丑闻持续发酵:Cardioband经导管瓣环成形装置在欧洲多家医院的使用受到审查
items.summary_zh: 苏黎世大学医院(USZ)心脏外科丑闻持续扩大:2026年4月底公布的独立调查委员会长达216页的报告显示,2016至2020年在时任科室主任Francesco Maisano任内,基于约4500例手术的统计分析,该院心外科死亡人数较同级别大学医院预期高出68-74例;报告认为其中部分死亡与其亲自参与研发的经导管瓣环成形装置Cardioband(Edwards Lifesciences)在无明确临床指征情况下被使用有关。苏黎世检方已就涉嫌过失杀人、过失重伤及伪造文书立案调查,医院董事会三名成员已辞职。随着事件发酵,伯尔尼Inselspital医院已启动对本院36例Cardioband手术的独立复查(目前未发现与手术存在直接时间关联的死亡),德国部分医院也表示仅在复杂三尖瓣反流个案中审慎使用该装置,反映出结构性心脏病创新器械在适应证把关、安全监测与知情同意方面的行业反思。
items.summary_en: The cardiac-surgery scandal at University Hospital Zurich (USZ) continues to widen: a 216-page independent commission report released in late April 2026 found that, based on statistical analysis of roughly 4,500 operations performed between 2016 and 2020 under then-department head Francesco Maisano, the unit's mortality was 68-74 cases higher than expected versus peer university hospitals -- attributing some deaths to use of the Cardioband transcatheter annuloplasty device (Edwards Lifesciences), which Maisano helped develop, in cases without clear clinical indication. Zurich prosecutors have opened a criminal investigation for suspected negligent homicide, negligent grievous bodily harm, and document forgery, and three hospital board members have resigned. In response, Bern's Inselspital has launched an independent review of its own 36 Cardioband cases (no deaths with a direct temporal link to the procedure found so far), while some German hospitals say they now use the device only selectively in complex tricuspid-regurgitation cases -- prompting broader reflection across structural heart interventions on indication selection, safety monitoring, and informed consent for novel devices.

items.title: POPular ACE TAVI: Routine vs Selective Protamine Administration to Reduce Bleeding After TAVI
items.title_zh: POPular ACE TAVI试验(ESC 2026 Hot Line):常规鱼精蛋白中和肝素可减少TAVI术后出血,但需警惕过敏反应风险升高
items.summary_zh: 在ESC 2026年会Hot Line环节公布的POPular ACE TAVI试验,由荷兰St Antonius医院牵头发起,为双盲安慰剂对照随机试验,纳入约1000例经股动脉TAVI患者(平均年龄80岁)按1:1随机分组,比较大鞘管拔除前常规给予鱼精蛋白中和肝素与选择性给药两种策略。结果显示,常规鱼精蛋白组30天全因死亡或临床相关出血复合终点较选择性给药组降低10.9个百分点(P<0.001),获益主要来自轻微出血事件减少;但过敏反应发生率也随之升高,绝对风险差为1.3个百分点(P=0.01)。研究提示常规鱼精蛋白中和是简单易行的TAVI出血预防策略,但心脏团队需为偶发过敏反应做好应对准备。
items.summary_en: Presented as a Hot Line trial at ESC Congress 2026, the investigator-initiated, double-blind, placebo-controlled POPular ACE TAVI trial (led by St Antonius Hospital, the Netherlands) randomized roughly 1,000 transfemoral TAVI patients (mean age 80) 1:1 to routine versus selective protamine administration before large-bore sheath removal. Routine protamine reduced the 30-day composite of all-cause death or clinically relevant bleeding by 10.9 percentage points (P<0.001), driven mainly by fewer minor bleeding events, but was associated with a higher rate of anaphylaxis (absolute risk difference 1.3 percentage points, P=0.01) -- a simple bleeding-reduction strategy that requires heart teams to prepare for occasional allergic reactions.

items.title: Heartvue.ai and Innolitics Achieve FDA 510(k) Clearance for Heartvue.Proton, an AI-Powered Cardiac MRI Analysis Platform
items.title_zh: Heartvue.ai与Innolitics的AI心脏磁共振分析平台Heartvue.Proton获FDA 510(k)批准
items.summary_zh: 总部位于美国田纳西州的医疗影像AI公司Heartvue.ai(由范德堡大学心脏病学家Jeffrey Dendy创立)联合Innolitics于2026年9月2日宣布,其心脏磁共振(CMR)图像查看与定量分析软件Heartvue.Proton获美国FDA 510(k)批准(批准号K260811),为该公司首次提交即获批准。该软件利用AI算法自动完成二维线性测量、心室容积与射血分数计算及血流定量分析,可对接医院PACS/EHR系统嵌入现有影像工作流,所有结果仍需临床医生审核确认;此次批准还包含预设变更控制计划(PCCP),允许模型在预设范围内迭代升级而无需逐次重新申报,拓宽了结构性心脏病影像评估中AI辅助定量分析的应用场景。
items.summary_en: Brentwood, Tennessee-based Heartvue.ai, founded by Vanderbilt cardiologist Jeffrey Dendy, announced on September 2, 2026, that it and partner Innolitics received FDA 510(k) clearance (K260811) for Heartvue.Proton, an AI-powered platform for viewing, post-processing, and quantitative evaluation of cardiovascular MRI, achieved on the company's first FDA submission. The software automates 2D linear measurements, ventricular volume/ejection-fraction calculation, and blood-flow quantification, integrating into existing PACS/EHR workflows while keeping every result under physician review; the clearance includes an FDA-authorized Predetermined Change Control Plan allowing model updates within pre-specified bounds without new 510(k) filings, broadening AI-assisted quantitative imaging options relevant to structural heart evaluation.
